hints.title: Input Type Detection
hints.text: Distinguish email addresses from telephone numbers by scanning for the presence of an at symbol.

hints.title: Email Case Normalization
hints.text: Convert email name and domain to lowercase, masking intermediate characters with exactly five asterisks.

hints.title: Phone Digit Extraction and Prefixing
hints.text: Filter all digits from the phone string. Keep the last four digits, prepend standard asterisks, and add a country code prefix if total digits exceed ten.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maskPII(self, s: str) -> str:
        if '@' in s:
            name, domain = s.lower().split('@')
            return f"{name[0]}*****{name[-1]}@{domain}"
        digits = [ch for ch in s if ch.isdigit()]
        local = "".join(digits[-4:])
        n = len(digits)
        if n == 10:
            return f"***-***-{local}"
        prefix = '*' * (n - 10)
        return f"+{prefix}-***-***-{local}"
```
